content.title: Atlético Madrid vs FC Barcelona - Live Stream
content.text: Home Live Stream Schedule Results News Videos Atlético Madrid vs FC Barcelona - Live Stream Your local time: Tue, April 14, 2026 at 15:00 View the live stream, TV coverage details and live score for the Atlético Madrid vs FC Barcelona, a UEFA Champions League quarter-final match.A place in the UEFA Champions League semi-finals is on the line as Atlético Madrid host FC Barcelona in a high-stakes quarter-final second leg at the Metropolitano on Tuesday, April 14, 2026. Atlético carry a commanding 2–0 advantage from the first leg at Camp Nou, leaving Barcelona in need of a bold comeback to keep their European campaign alive. Kick-off is set for 21:00 CET (local Madrid time), which corresponds to 15:00 US Eastern Time, and the early stages could prove decisive as Barcelona chase goals against Diego Simeone’s typically disciplined defensive setup in front of a charged home crowd.Atlético Madrid vs FC Barcelona – TV & Streaming CoverageCountry / RegionChannel / Package / StreamingGreat BritainViewers in UK can watch the match live on: TNT Sports 1HBO MAXUnited StatesSoccer fans in the US can watch the match live on:Paramount+ (English commentary)ViX (Spanish commentary)TUDNCanadaCanadian football fans follow the match live on DAZN Canada and Fubo TV Canada.GermanyDAZN 1 Germany.PortugalIn Portugal the game will be broadcast live on DAZN Portugal.ItalyIn Italy fans can access the live coverage on: Sky Sport channel 253SKY Go ItaliaNOW TVSky Sports CsalcioNetherlandsZiggo Sports channel 2 and Zigo Sports Go will provide live coverage in Netherlands.BelgiumFootball fans in Belgium can follow the match live on:Proximus PickxRTL CliubVTM GoPlay Sports 3SpainMovistar Plus+ – M+ Liga de Campeones LALIGA TV BAR (Dial 300) will broadcast the match live in Spain.SwedenThe live coverage of the match will be available on Viaplay.NorwayThe Norwegian football fans can watch the match live on TV 2 Play.FranceCanal + Live 2, My Canal and Free TV France will provide live coverage for French football fans.WorldwideSee UEFA Champions League Broadcast Partners by Country.Note: Broadcast schedules and partners are subject to change.
